text: If you give this place anything other than 5 stars go pound sand.  I have no affiliation with these guys.  But for real.  This is what most places lack.  Originality, atmosphere, and good pizza. Joanies for life.
This place offers fast delivery and I have yet to try one of their pies that I didn't like. The tomato pie is second to none. Love this place.
We will be back here again . The oysters, mussels and ceviche were very fresh.  The salad was enough to feed two and our waiter was outstanding .

A co worker first took me to lunch at Tamira and I had never really had Indian food before. Turns out I really like it!! Great service, great food, a really nice lunch spot. Love the open air seating in the front too!
Love this place, always a great breakfast or lunch, reasonable prices and pleasant wait staff

Hands down one of my top brunch experiences, and I'm a foodie from San Francisco. The ambiance, menu, and service were above and beyond. The Portland-esque hip decor and lighting with communal tables that are divided into groups of four seats - just enough privacy and just enough people watching. 300+ whiskey selections and a separate Old Fashioned Bar. Some of the best farm to table cuisine. 

My friend and I ordered fried green tomatoes, farmer's breakfast,  whiskey-braised short rib hash, and whiskey cake. My favorite savory dish was the farmer's breakfast - a combination plate of eggs, potatoes, bacon, grits, and jalapeno cheddar biscuits. Seems simple right? Not at all. This is one of the breakfast plates I've eaten with the best execution and quality. The eggs were fresh and perfectly fluffy - just what you would expect from top-notch local farm eggs. The sweet and spicy thick cherry cut bacon was chewy with a burst of equal parts sweet and pepper at the same time. The thick chewy texture of the bacon made every bite explode with flavor. This wasn't one of those typical crunchy, skinny, easily broken pieces of bacon; this was bacon that you wanted to take time to eat, to savor. Equally delicious was the grits - buttery, creamy, and exactly what you would want from Southern grits. Lastly, the jalapeno cheddar biscuits were cheesy, not too spicy, and the ideal texture mix of flaky and bready. I just ate this plate yesterday and am already dreaming to go back.

Definitely

Randomly stopped by this restaurant with a friend last week and I've been back another two times already. Service is phenomenal and all the employees are very genuine. Will continue to bring my friends here.
Surprisingly yummy tacos! They had good reviews, but being from Southern California (so close to Mexico) I'm very particular about tacos. These were great!

Awesome music. Bartender is a total a$&hole.
Accused us of bringing beer from another bar when we bought them from there. Then refused to serve us another beer. Definitely will go back but not if he is working.

This is a great spot. We visit pretty regularly and mostly order pizza. They have a lot of great looking pastas and other entrees. The salads are quite good. There are some excellent appetizers. We have really enjoyed the Arricini rice ball appetizer.  I like the ambiance of a traditional pizza parlor. It is fun and casual!  I increased my star rating because of having many consistently good meals! They offer carryout and that is nice to do sometimes as well.
Amazing food, amazing service, great music! Will definitely be back! Especially for the fried green tomatoes with shrimp.

Barcelona has a lot of great things going for it: hip atmosphere, good menu, and a perfect location that is quaint but cozy. This experience however failed to meet expectations. 

Other than a great night between family and friends, the food was sub-par and disappointing. We ordered the grilled hangar steak, albondigas, and a large paella. The hangar steak was the most expensive tapas on the menu, and by far the smallest. The steak slices looked bigger on the online website; they tasted good, but lacked an appealing presentation. The albondigas were the unexpected highlight and tasted quite good. On the contrary, the biggest letdown of the evening was the lumpy, undercooked, raw paella. 

Not only did the dish take 20 minutes longer than it was estimated to come out, according to others at our table, was dare I say, "awful". I don't eat paella often, and even I was able to tell how severely undercooked the rice was. It was practically a risotto dish - clumpy, watery, and creamy. While the plating and presentation looked appetizing, the result was anything but. I ate a decent amount because I was so hungry from the wait, but we didn't even touch the shrimp or 3/4 of the clams. Thankfully, the manager was accommodating and understanding, but we still left shocked and saddened by what was our most anticipated dish of the night.

I'd like to give Barcelona another try in the future because it's such a quaint spot with a rich menu, though tonight left an unsatisfying taste in mout

Let me start off by saying this was my first time going to Texas Roadhouse and I came from NC to surprise my family up here. So it's a party of 8 we all pick out our steaks before we're seated. So after we order our sides and how we want our steaks we wait..20min later another waitress comes and ask my aunt which steak did you pick. She says I had a tbone you have my ticket.. so we wait about 15 min and the table in front of us (of 4) gets there food. 10min later the table (of 6) behind us gets their food. Now we're all like wait a minute. Maybe 10min later almost an hour we get our food 3 of the 8 steaks are wrong I ask for done no pink mine is medium rare, my aunt steak, tbone was supposed to have fat on the outside it didnt and it was burnt. And my other cousin didnt have onions or cheese on hers. So I send mine back and by time it comes back I tell them to box it to go. After driving to the restaurant for over an hour from Philly me or my family will ever come back again. Disappointed is an understatement
If you enjoy supporting local business be sure to check in to Jimmy's Tacos in Ybor City. Solid tacos, but be sure to get a side of rice and beans. The best yellow rice I have ever had.

My husband and I went here for happy hour. We had the quail and waffles, tamale meatballs, duck etouffee and croque ham sandwich. It was all delicious. We also got the Rocco, the hair of the dog, old fashion and my drinking is only a problem for you. The drinks were nice and strong. Overall, I would highly recommend them.

This place is worth the hype! The slab of ribs that I got was so much food I was eating on it for days! The ribs came out perfectly, they were still steaming as we dug in for lunch.  

I tried a sangria and definitely went back for a second one. The decision to get a sangria was rough though. ALL of the drinks sound delicious. And what is a Kombucha mule? I don't know,  I didn't get to try it. Now, I have to go back!

I really wish there was a 1/2 star option because I would rate Cantina a 3.5.  I think a lot of people see a 3 star review and think there was something wrong, but honestly there is nothing wrong with Cantina, it's just very average. The half star I'm adding because the service was good. 

We had house margaritas, and two different burritos. The meat in the burritos was good, but overall nothing special. The beans on the side were good, but the rice not so much. The margaritas were fine, but again, nothing special. The salsa they served with the chips was pretty good. 

All-in-all it was a perfectly fine experience, but nothing really stands out. Would I go back? Honestly, this was our second time there, so apparently I would, but only because of the Costco deal on their gift cards. I wouldn't tell anyone to not at least try this place though and decide for themselves, you could do much worse.
Best fried chicken EVER! All the side are amazing and the drinks are super tasty.  I'm gluten-free and I can still eat here.  Just not the chicken anymore...so sad!

If you like fried food, this is your place! Almost everything was fried. The food was delicious to me. My daughter wasn't impressed, but she is 9 and isn't a fried food fanatic. The beans were awesome. They give you so much food, you have to pace yourself. I shared the seafood platter with my daughter and got her a kids meal. Kids meals are about the cost of the "fixings" so it was the same price. We took majority home. The waitress was very friendly and helpful. The kid even got a free ice cream after the smorgasbord. Overall a good experience for the price.

3 stars vs 5. Here is the reason why. 
 The pork cops and the side salad was excellent!  My dad steak was great. 
 And now the reason it got 3. 
 
  When we got their at 5:00. The wait time was 25-35 min long. In which it was so strange that  there was so many empty tables in the dinning area. So we decide to sit in the bar. They had one table that was clean that we took. 4 other  tables had dirty dishes on them. Even when we place our order 10 minutes later. The same four table still have not been cleared off.  Even when we enjoy our meal. People got up and left.  There plates where still on the table for long time.  Longhorn needs to work on that part. 
  
  We waited 8 minutes to have somebody drop off menus. And we had another person grab our drinks.  Finally our server showed up.  He had three tables in the bar and then three other tables in the dining room. That didn't really make any sense.  The service good. But the food made the night.

The best cheese steak and fries EVER! They make it to my specific liking every time! If you haven't been to this restaurant - you are truly missing out on incredible food.  Menu is upscale, fresh ingredients and fantastic service.  I literally would eat here every day.  Thank you, thank you and thank you to the Chef, staff and best delivery guy out there!
Great pizza!!  Newer to the area and tried Russo's for the first time. GIANT large size... all really great. Now our go-to pie place in New Hope.

Ordered a roast beef sandwich to go, asked for leaf lettuce, salt, pepper, oil and vinegar. The sandwich came out quickly given it was lunchtime but the box containing the sandwich was pretty light considering the $12+ price. I opened the box and the sandwich looked like a small dinner roll with a few slices of roast beef covered with shredded lettuce, no sign of vinegar and oil. It's a shame, the roast beef was pretty tasty but way overpriced.

My bf and I came to Santa Barbara for the weekend to celebrate his bday. We walked around the strip looking for ideas to have for dinner. We arrived at Hibachi about 30 minutes before closing and they still welcomed us and seated us. Our servers name was Omar, His energy was great! Omar gave exceptional customer services, he kept it very professional all while making us feel like friends! His energy was bright & cheerful. Even recommended a couple of places to visit. The food was also very great. The restaurant resembles Benihanas but way more reasonable in pricing. Only payed 80 something bucks for all the food ordered. This place is a must! I definitely recommend it.
The duck was fantastic! I've never had a duck that was so moist and tender. I also got the scallion pancakes which were also good!

Do NOT try to go to any events here. They will steal your money. Because two places were hosting murder mystery events we accidentally ended up at the wrong one. We asked fishers to reschedule they said we could but then ran us In A ton of circles about when they would have dates for this event. On the phone Cathy was EXTREMELY RUDE so we went in the same day and asked for a refund. They said on the website that there is a 'no cancellation' policy. I couldn't find it so I asked Cathy to see it. She couldn't find it and lied and said the website wasn't working. I could clearly see it's reflection in the photo behind her. I asked where on the website I might look for the policy and Cathy told me it was none of my business where their policy was. If you have a policy you want to enforce then yes, as a paying customer you're trying to deny a refund to, it is my right to see the cancellation policy. She then refused to let us speak to another manager when I told her she was being rude she told us to leave or she would call the cops on us. We Will now be filing a charge back since no one can produce this cancellation policy and no one will tell us where to find it. Because it doesn't exist. If I could give no stars I would. Proceed with caution.
Love this pizza! I get the deep dish square pizza and it never dissapoints. It's thick cheesy saucy and meaty. Both this and the st charles locations have never given me a bad pie.

Ahhh... Boathouse. I have many fond memories at this place and all of them have been wonderful. 

First off- the setting. You can't beat it. Right on what feels like a secluded beach in Santa Barbara. The view alone is worth going for!

But now- lets get to the food. I'm reviewing some of the apps I had:

- Steamed Manila Clams ($14.95, $8.95 during HH)- Heaven!!! I love seafood but I wouldn't call myself a clam person. These are heavenly. The wine sauce is to die for! We asked for extra bread because it was so good.

-Lobster & Truffle Mac N Cheese ($16.95, $11.95 during HH)- okay, by the title alone you know it's going to be good. It was cooked to perfection. Nice big lobster chunks in it too! 

-Baja Style Fish Tacos ($8.95 during HH) also very good! The fish quality is amazing. We got ours blackened. 

Overall- great place, great good, great service. That's a five star rating from me! Can't wait to come back.

**TIP: If you're looking to save a few bucks check out the Happy Hour menu.

Overalll the experience was goood. We had a reservation because we had 12 people. Starting with the Pretzel and cheese was a good decision. My sister and I split the nachos and warm Brussels sprout salad. Nachos were loaded pretty high and I would definitely recommend. The salad was pretty good as well, very unique. Overall it took a little longer to get our food but we did have a lot of people and it was at 7 on a Saturday
Pere Antoine has a wonderful view for parades or people watching. The shrimp étouffée was average. This is a great place to sit and watch the parade have a glass of wine and appetizer.
Tasty pizza. Quick preparation of the food! I will continue to order from here. I also got fries and enjoyed the sauce.

Had chicken wings delivered. Absolutely ice cold. All the sauce was on the bottom of the box with dry cold wings on top. Wings tasted like fried cardboard although I ordered baked. 

Have been here a number of times for indoor dining and really liked it (although it looks like they eliminated the entrees I ordered). I will never order delivery again. Very disappointed.
Tasty, inexpensive Mexican food available for delivery through multiple services. Queso con chorizo is the best!

I come here probably once a month... ha! I also have now started to order delivery via Postmates and it's just as amazing (and they even wrap up your bread and olive oil!) It's seriously one of my favorite penne vodkas in the city. OH -- and their caesar salad is also to die for... yes.. the salad is that good.

What an amazing place!  We were missing our cats back home and this gave us th fix that we needed.  The cats were so friendly and we quickly bonded with many of them.  Staff was extremely nice and was happy to answer any questions we had.  Would come back again!
Great place to sit outside and get a couple of appetizers. They are operating at an "open" status right now but they do take your temperature when you walk inside.

Used to love this place. They have screwed me over the past 3 times with ubereats. Wrong order or they shut down ubereats an hour and half before closing hours and then you go to order in the timeframe they have posted hours but get screwed and mostly just fast food crap available after that than. Give customers the correct hours on ubereats! Ridiculous

Delivery order. Very good pizza and delivered on time with no issues.

Ill try them again:
- margharita pizza was good
- loved deSano pizza.

Good times for not a lot of money.  Batting cages were good.  Drinks were reasonably priced.  Had a good
Time, well probably go back and try the food and hit again.
Delicious coffee. Wonderful staff. Relaxing environment. Nice art!! Support local business!!
Great burger, but long wait and a very tight space.
Excellent food and customer service.  I was having a horrible day and the woman at the front put a smile on my face.  Full size sandwich is humongous!   Fries were crispy.  Will definitely go back.

Recommend going elsewhere as of march 22 2019.  Ordered a full salad received a half salad. Asked and showed the manager. He said they, like many other Penera locations have just implemented "portion measurement and control".  Profits over customers.
So they advertise Mac and cheese on the outside sign board and don't serve it. The person inside is also soooo rude. Lots of places to eat nearby. Don't waste your time here

We stopped by for lunch this past Friday for a quick lunch. We arrived around 1:00 and it was dead. Over the years this place has changed hands numerous times. I think Momma Mia's could make it though. The staff were very friendly and the food was good. We went with fries and a large half white with ricotta and Margherita. The fries were good, typical frozen with skin on. They were crispy and hot. The cheese whiz was real but it didn't taste fresh, the color was a bit off and wasn't very creamy. Easily overlooked though. The pizza was very good. Everything tasted fresh. The pizza had a nice crunchy crust and it was thin, just like we prefer. The sauce was spot on! Not too sweet but not overly acidic. Just the right amount of sauce too. My only complaint would be the menu listed basil with the white, it didn't come with it. Also, I would have preferred more ricotta. 

Overall though it was a very good pizza for a good value. Hopefully they get a fountain machine! Lol We will for sure stop back in! 4 stars.

very disappointed to say the least. to start we were told it would be a 45 min wait and that turned into an hour and 15 min wait. we finally got a seat and had to wait another 20 min to be served. once we were served we waited about 15 min then my food was brought out and no one else in my party received their food. another 15 min and my boy andy got his food. fast forward another 10 min and the rest of my party was served. however it was very questionable because my black friend donny was served last??? not to mention they got his order wrong. thought it was over...no, there were flies everywhere, people walking around unmasked, and we didn't get fast refills. despite all of this the entertainment level was there and i enjoyed the bangers being played. i've been a loyal customer for the past 4 years but this experience is making me question my loyalty.

Monday Night Happy Hour definitely gets 5 starts !!! Michelle was fantastic !!! all of our food was great ! we had  short rip tacos, dry wings, steamed clams and a caesar salad with grilled chicken and shrimp, we had orange crushes and georgia peach frozen drinks ! So glad we came here !

So I give the 4 stars for the following.  

I got the birch beer/vanilla gelati, when I looked up after ordering, I saw the employee putting the soft serve in the cup..geez I didn't even see him scoop the water-ice.

I was served the desert on a tray (nice touch) and when I dipped the spoon in the ice-cream, I saw the water-ice on the bottom. It was frozen solid. So the water-ice is pre-portioned and frozen hence the quickness not seeing the employee put water-ice in a cup. 

two things: 1, this is good for quicker service, 2, not so good is the water-ice is frozen hard, you can't even mix the ice cream in with it, so what's the point. That's why I gave 4 stars. 

You have to eat most of the ice-cream before it melts running down the sides of the cup onto your hand which takes the fun and purpose out of the gelati mixing it or having a taste of both the same time. 

However, I will say that the taste of both ice-cream and water-ice is pretty damn good. I just wish or hope that they change the water-ice to freshly dipped to acquire the gelati effect. I'd go back and if I want the gelati again, I may be bound to buy the ice cream and water-ice separate.  The sandwiches, look good and i'll be back to try them.
Ordered half white, half mushroom and onions for pick-up before the game.  A little pricey, but oh so yummy!

The Gingerbread Coffee from Kitchen House was very good! I'm typically not a gingerbread fan but this exceeded all expectations. 

I also tried a deliciously soft chocolate chip cookie. Super good!

While traveling for work, and waiting to head the the airport, I had the opportunity to dine here. I'm a hard sell, as I work in the hospitality industry myself. But this was one of the best meals I've had while traveling alone. Not only was the food great (and it was), but the service I received from Jeremy was top notch. 

It has been a couple years since I had hot pot, and I've never done it solo, but Jeremy not only expertly helped guide me through the process, but also ensured that I didn't over-order (as I had a plane to catch, anything I didn't eat would have gone to waste).

This is a great spot, and I will absolutely be back, whenever I end up back in Philadelphia!

What a wonderful experience for our anniversary! Duncann was our waiter and he made our evening so special! We had steaks and then he surprised us with a yummy ice cream dessert. A nice manager also came and congratulated us on our anniversary. Thank you for making us feel special!

Came in for lunch with a girlfriend today to try something new.. Andrew was our server and made the experience!! So friendly and attentive. He was also very knowledgeable of the menu and answered our questions helpfully and honesty. Would love to come back -- especially if he's our server again!!

First trip having a fun food ad entire with my family. People were waiting but it took less than five minutes to be seated. Quick service. Hot chicken buns were great. Chicken dumplings preferred by some and not others.  I had Maz and Cheese. Delicious but spicy which I wasn't expecting. Not bad though. My other diners had TN  Tonkotsu and Spicy Miso. They both liked it but it's more than you can finish in one meal. Music is loud and makes it hard to talk but enjoyed our visit.

Vegans like this place because they probably don't know any better or remember what meat tastes like...

I'm not a vegan but I dig vegan food and maybe it's just something you need to get used to but The Reuben tastes like glue with a hint of fennel. I can't speak to any of their other products and I'd honestly still be williing to go back and try the tuna and chicken salad and update my review if it tastes better. Front counter people were nice though and doing their best.

Cracker Barrel is a pretty well known, family restaurant. The food is pretty good & decently priced. Maybe its just this location and the night the waiter was having but the service is def 1 out of 5. We were a party of 7 and 3 were kids. You would assume kids would get their food first, you know b/c they're kids ages 3,6,&7. no....2 adult meals & 1 kid meal out first...STRIKE 1. dropped 1 order l...STRIKE 2....when it came back STILL wrong...STRIKE 3...usually in baseball you're out. Usually have patience for all this and understanding but then 3 out 7 side orders were wrong, no biscuits and cornbread served, grinds in the coffee. to add insult to injury she expected to pay for the 1 meal she messed up 3x without apologizing. oh and DO being a sweater or jacket....its freezing in there. great way to make profit guys as sweaters are like $40
Great sushi! The best I've ever had for sure. The place is tiny and there is always a wait - a wait to get seated and a wait to get your order. But, I think it's worth the wait(s)!

What a cool little cafe this is. The special for the day was everything. And I swear, the waitress rattled off everything on the menu. She had a fast tongue and a great personality.  The mimosas were perfect and the atmosphere was warm. Although they don't have a craps table, I think this place has potential. We will see how the food goes. Holy crap that was superb. Thanks to chef Georgie. He has added to this menu and sounds like he has a creative side that has helped this business grow. The ultimate of ultimate is the owner. Well, owners father who started the place. I was too early to meet the owner but the gentleman that started this business was out and about, roaming the floor. He came over and I was so pleased to meet him. He has a spirit in him that glows. Very cool guy. The type of work mentality that this new generation needs to see. Overall,,,,,awesome place.

Of all the places where you can get a seafood boil in Indy this is the best one. This place also doesn't skimp on serving size you get what you pay for and then some. The seafood is fresh and when you order spicy it is actually spicy. We ordered the super platter and it was honestly way too much food for us but so delicious.

Get the chicken wings and chili. Excellent. Another favorite is the triple decker BLT. Must be an entire slab of bacon in it! No kids at all if you're dining in, but have done great for us with takeout in the pandemic. The Friendly is an old Zionsville staple and worth a stop if you're on the brick street.
12/23/20 had shrimp appetizer and two orders of boneless wings both were overcooked and disappointing and for desert our credit card was compromised we will never be back

So yummy! I got the grand slam McMuffin, without cheese but added scrambled egg, and it was slightly greasy but delicious. The crispy hashbrown and grilled onions in that sandwich are a really nice touch. The iced chai was great and refreshing. Dining room is closed, but they have a couple of outdoor tables that are nice to sit down at on a nice day!

I went here on accident but thought I would give it a try after seeing the menu I changed my mind because there wasn't many options waited for about 10 minutes after receiving our drinks so we could tell the waiter we were leaving he didn't come back so we went up to tell the main area we were leaving and wanted to pay for our drinks we ordered 1 lemonade and 1 strawberry lemonade just lemonades no alcohol and our bill was 9$ and some change I would understand paying that much if they had big cups but the cups that u drink from are small if we woulda poured both drinks into a water bottle it wouldn't even be have full I had never used this app before but after going their I felt a need to download it.

I've patronized Little Greek for many years, usually from the Ulmerton Rd location near Feather Sound, but I've also enjoyed Little Greek's catering services at One Buc Place and the training facility for special events. However, this was my first experience with the Gulf to Bay location, even though my office is only a couple of miles away.

My officemate ordered online for our lunch on a Friday in early December 2020. Because her son is still virtually attending third grade in our office, we had more than $50 of food in our order. Lead time was about 35 minutes around 12:15pm, which gave me time to stop for gas on my way to Pinellas from my house in Town & Country. My colleague had sent me the order details along with the phone number to call when I arrived. But she'd also included my vehicle info when placing the order, so I'd barely parked before a friendly employee came out with our order. Though she was wearing a mask, she was clearly smiling as she handed me two heavy bags.

Our food smelled SO GOOD! And it was all very delicious as well. I'd ordered falafel, spanakopita & baklava, expecting to share. But the 8-yr old aggressively insisted he didn't like falafel, so I got it all. Interestingly, he ate all of the hummus his mother had ordered and then demanded more. Later, he didn't want his baklava so I got that too, which I took home to hubs and it was promptly devoured. The spanakopita was my favorite though, as it usually is, and the bit I couldn't eat that day warm

Very good food, but beware of their overlooking policy. My fiancee had to wait 45 minutes to be seated, and then we waited another 45 minutes to receive our appitizer.. Very disappointing experience. For the star rating, I would give 5 stars for food and zero stars for service and, sorry to say, management, since this was, after all, a management caused problem. The waiters were working very hard... but management over booked like crazy.
I went to the drive through it took 15 minutes to process my order and they still put mayonnaise on the sandwich.

I came here one night after working back to back shifts at Ochsner's. I was super tired and hungry. I googled a place close by and Ron's came up. As soon as I entered I was greeted by both the hostess and  the chef himself, both asking about how I'm doing and to make myself at home. This truly made me feel this was a family oriented establishment. I ordered food to go and sat at the bar to wait. I was served a drink of my choice and went on my way. Now the food hit every corner from the moment it entered my mouth. I had seafood gumbo and a fried shrimp poboy. Y'all I was highly satisfied with my meal and will definitely come back again soon!
Yes yes yes excellent VEGAN food, and even carnivores will enjoy bc it's tasty and well priced. Please never go away from Gulfport. We love you!!
Excellent!! So many things to choice from. Been here three times this week and always a great experience. The servers are really nice and very helpful.

I purchased these in preparation for an upcoming surgery.  Tried one today to make sure I liked it (pulled pork mac and cheese) and YUM, delicious! This was perfectly portioned out and didn't leave me starving after I was done.  I was so happy to find this and will definitely continue ordering.  Super convenient!!!

Not a fan of this place. We ordered two po boys and both were mediocre. One was shrimp and the other was roast beef. The roast beef was sliced instead of shredded and the slices were a bit too thick. Each bite required a little tug. Not exactly what I would call tender. And the shrimp one was just okay.

In any other city, this place probably would have gotten a 3-star rating from me, but since it's competing against other places in NOLA, all I can honestly give it is a very disappointing 2.

Was really looking forward to eating here since I have tried a few locations and have loved them.  We used the waitlist app, which worked nicely and we were even seated early. Our server was very nice, but disappeared after the meals were delivered and we saw him mixing drinks at the bar. I order the Salmon avocado toast and my aunt ordered the pumpkin waffle meal. My toast looked like skinny pieces of old frozen bread, the salmon looked a little gray and the avocado was brown and very thinly spread on the bread. I doubt there was 1 Tbsp of smashed avocado total for both pieces of bread. I ordered a poached egg that looked like it had been in the water for maybe 20 seconds. I don't know how the yolk even stayed together and the white was watery/snotty. My aunt's waffle was underdone and her eggs were cold. Really a let down since I was so looking forward to this being so close to my apartment...and I won't be going back.
Great food!! Had their spicy pork burrito! My husband had the kalbi burrito! Try both!! :)

I heard nothing but amazing things about Martins and wanted some authentic bbq during my quick trip to Nashville and they did not disappoint!! We tried all the sides and I got the pork platter. We got hush puppies, coleslaw, baked beans, Mac and cheese, fries and potato salad. I definitely could not pick a favorite! The pulled pork was a little dry and the band ended early which is why I deducted one star. I would give it a 4.5 if I could! All of the sides were fantastic, loved the alabama bbq sauce and I loved the atmosphere. The band they had was really great too!! Staff was very friendly and gave great recommendations. Would definitely recommend and would come back whenever I'm in Nashville again.

I really enjoyed most my food. I got the BBQ chicken and some pork ribs. Mac and cheese. Tomato okra and corn. Greens. Coconut cake and banana pudding. My mom got the fried whiting. My mom liked whiting. My chicken and ribs and Mac and cheese were great. Mom said there was too much sugar in the greens. My true complaints were the desserts. The pudding for the banana pudding was too loose. And the coconut cake was a little tough and sweeeeeettt. And I like sweet but it was too much for me

I had a horrific experience at this restaurant.  I had never been there before.  The food and service were great BUT, when I attempted to pay for the bill, the server came back and stated that there was an error on the card and that he could not process it.  I asked, in front of my guests, if I would be charged and he stated that HE REVERSED THE ERROR.
I handed him a second card and he came back and said there was a problem.  He said he would have another person try it.  I walked to the bar to watch her attempt and she stated that the first card was declined and that it went through on the second card.  This was all stated loudly in front of customers.
When I got home, I contacted both banks.  The first bank stated the three charges were attempted and immediately reversed.  On the fourth attempt, the bank declined the charge believing it to be fraudulent.
The second bank stated that there were FIVE pending charges for the same amount.
When I called to speak to a manager, I was met with indifference and abruptness.
Despite the quality of the food, because of the shame and embarrassment this caused me, I WILL NEVER VISIT THIS ESTABLISHMENT AGAIN.

There are two sushi places closer to my house, but I drive to Sushi Kampai for all my sushi to-go needs. I judge sushi places by their spicy tune roll, so I can truly compare "apples to apples". Kampai's Spicy Tune Roll is good, but the Kampai Roll is excellent!!! Add a miso soup and seaweed salad to call it dinner. 

I have also eat their General Tso, which is a little sweeter than I like, but the quality of the chicken in it is the best I have ever found! It is real chicken chunks, instead of fatty tendons and gristle like many Chinese places. It only comes with white rice, so be prepared to drop another $8 for a full order of fried rice because that's the only size they have and substitutions are not allowed.

So im writing as im sitting here in the bar. As usual all the food is on point, the wings and sliders just amazing. Now i sat at the bar as usual the girls are on point and amazing with service.
Stacey and Shelby are outstanding bartenders with on point service and attentiveness. 

I want to give props to Joey the server as well even though he is a waiter and not at the bar. The man was on fire and high speed bringing food back to tables and the bar! Great work mentality and ethic!

I don't make postive comments for nothing, 1356 overall is a great place for food and drinks!

Here at The Rum House, sitting outside on the patio and enjoying the breeze.  My friends and I shared the avocado mango dip, which was super tasty.  I participated in happy hour with $5 rum punch, and their specialty taco! I tried the Lambsbread taco and the Fried Calamari taco and it was Bomb.com
Great place, excellent service and drinks. Food is delicious and servers are helpful and friendly. Great for a date night or getaway to watch the games

Crabby's is a must anytime you are in CWB. They have 3 floors of dining, offering indoor/outdoor options, as well as open air. The location is fabulous with views of the marina & the gulf, & beautiful sunsets. The menu is varied & food is good!  If you are looking for the bar vibe pop up to 3rd floor & see Phrank behind the bar, he made our visit very enjoyable. We had the Big Bowl clams & mussels in garlic with Texas toast, it was very good! Everyone was friendly & keeping it all clean & safe.

Compared to other PJ's locations, this restaurant/bar is definitely a step above. Brand new construction- very clean, modern, great bar with TV's.  Nice spot to grab a beer and a quick dinner or watch a game too.  Outdoor seating is nice but lacks space.

This place is garbo. There are so many better mexican restaurants in the area. First of all dont even bother trying to get delivery. We tried twice and each time took upwards of an hour and a half. The estimate was 30 minutes. They even had the gull to call the postmate over and then promptly force the poor dude to wait 5-10 minutes for rice. When you're finally graced with the food some of it is cold, most is unseasoned, and none of it is satisfying. 2nd time also made me feel mildly sick as well. Just avoid it

COVID has created many challenges to the restaurant biz, but Hiroki demonstrated how to maintain a high-end dining experience with all of the bells and whistles while keeping up with the safety precautions.

Must get: omakase w/sake pairing

First of all, getting here is a little tricky with the dearth of parking (especially with the numerous one-way streets) and the GPS will actually take you to another restaurant, Wm Mulherin, but they share the same building and the entrance is on N. Lee St.

Upon entering Hiroki, you can immediately cast off all of the worries and the chaos and know you're in for an amazing and unforgettable evening. All of the seats are at the sushi bar, where you get to watch the sushi chefs expertly craft each dish with care and precision. The service was top notch and reminiscent of a Michelin restaurant with expedited water refills, pushing of the chairs, and just all around pleasant rapport. What I love about Hiroki, interestingly enough, is the placement of the hanging transparent glass to protect the patrons and diners from covid. The lighting of the glass catches the reflection of the Japanese paintings behind them, giving it a beautiful, but the eery appearance of floating ghosts dining with you.

In terms of the food, it was all excellent, with options ranging from mouth-watering and insta-melting fatty tuna to the perfectly marbled wagyu. Our tasting menu included delights such as barracuda, big eye snapper, and uni. The dessert was excellent

Love this place .. they have specialty items all Meade fresh . Gluten free options too. Coffee and other drinks . Great friendly service. Lots of honey for sale and they don't use sugar.. they use honey

Pretty lax with the COVID requirements on both the customer and employee side. I recently had the joy of standing in line behind a customer with no mask and watching a handful of employees not say a thing. Eat at your own risk  maybe they have ventilators for $0.99 too.

Very disappointed, every time we go there the food portions are smaller and the prices are higher. The food not so great, definitely overprice !! The chicken was dry, the beans over seasoned. Plantains were ok.  One start for the plantains and customer service

The food is good some thing better then others but the real problem is the wait ... 30 minutes for the bubble tea!  It like a Chinese takeout place but they won't let you inside due to covid.   It's ridiculous they need to get this thing under control with the wait times.  Sundays there's only the one owner woman working completely understaffed they needthey need to hire someone.

Fun place with great atmosphere. Pour your own beer/wine . My boyfriend and I did two beer flights for around 14$. Not too bad. Pizza we rated 7/10.  We got half pie classic with extra sauce and other half was a sausage and honey. 16$. Crust was definitely crispy which my boyfriend loved but it tasted a little cracker like to me. Service was okay. Some were friendly others were just there to do their jobs. It was never clear who was serving us bc we had more than one person. We got there 4pm at opening so all the servers weren't there yet and that may be why. All in all I would go back!

Little Nonna's had been on my short list with my good friend for many, many months. We ended up in the neighborhood after a happy hour and were able to sit at the counter without a reservation. The hostess and our server were awesome. The space is absolutely darling. We shared an order of meatballs for our antipasti and an order of the Rigatoni alla Vodka for our dinner. We also ordered a carafe of red table wine as you should when it's offered. Everything was amazing. 

Until, while we still had a few sips of wine, a few bites of Tiramisu and a few more minutes left to enjoy our night out, a pipe from the hotel above the restaurant burst and started raining on our seats and part of the kitchen. Our meal was not ruined, we had a great time and we understood that this was out of the restaurant staff's control. But, our leather jackets, handbags, phones and other electronics did get wet. When we went to pay the bill, our server mentioned comping the meal, called her manager and we were not comped anything. We didn't expect anything when we placed our CC's in the jacket, but after getting rained on and having our server mention a break it seemed weird to not get a little break or a gift card to come back. 

My three stars is a five star for the service, the food and the staff. I deducted two stars for management not understanding that comping the carafe of wine or providing a $25 GC to come back another time would have easily compensated for being rained on for 15 minutes and it

We came to handlebar for geeks who drink trivia in a Thursday night. I got two cocktails, both of which were very tasty but a little weak. The bartender was very nice and topped off my drink with the extra he made. $2 tallboys can't be beat. 

I tried my friend's beet fries and they were to die for. Fried veggies is a vegetarian's dream and handlebar has them in excess. I can't wait to come back and try the fried mushrooms and pickles and maybe even give the vegan or gluten free pizza a go!
Food tasted great and delivered as promised. My only complaint, they forgot ice cream in both deserts. How is a man to enjoy his peach blonde without the ice cream.

I've been there twice in the last month through the drive thru  and both times they shorted us on our chicken McNuggets they forgot napkins they forgot fries. We will never go back to this location again

Best breakfast in New Orleans.  Excellent food!  Great flavors and unique items.  I had the hangover bowl.  I normally don't like grits but these were awesome.   Definitely would go again.  You need reservations!

The salad bowl I got wasn't bad, except for the tiny portion size and the fact that it was topped with the most disgusting falafel I've ever had. It was cold, dense, crumbly, and a sickening puke green color. Absolutely not worth $10.
The gooey butter donut was just the right amount of sweet with the cake donut. No seats inside, so grab some coffee down the street and enjoy.

This place is a well oiled machine. They were fast and efficient. I ordered a create your own pizza. I liked how you can choose other sauces instead of the traditional red sauce for your pizza. I also loved how they have great topping selections! Most places will have black olives but never green olives. Kudos to Blaze for having those and overall a good topping selection. They looked fresh and were great on the pizza. They added a lot of toppings no skimping. The toppings to cheese ratio was perfect.

Once they added what you want they send it off to the fire oven. Once it's done you can pick "drizzles" to add to your pizza. I chose ranch which was great because I love ranch. Next time I will try the olive oil. They boxed it up in a nice box and off I go. I forgot to try the garlic knots and the s'mores they're known for. I will be back because it was a great pizza and the employees you could tell were happy and engaging with the customers. Lots of people coming in and out and they were on top of it.
The BEST breadsticks I have had in forever. Delicious. Nice atmosphere and fast service at lunch time.  Friendly service.

My two girlfriends and I decided to check out Chestnut Hill Brewing last night for Restaurant Week. For $25 you get a pint of beer or glass of wine, appetizer, pizza or pasta of choice, and a cookie. 

It was a little confusing to get to, all three of us had trouble finding the place. There was confusion about the taproom vs. the brewery. But no big deal, because the staff politely guided us in the right direction. Once inside, I was really impressed with the space. Industrial but cozy. We all got the pretzel, which was good minus the fennel, and pizza. The pizza was SO good. Our waiter and his trainee were friendly, attentive and knowledgeable about the menu. Excellent service! 

Overall, this was a great experience. Will def be back to try more of the delicious pizzas, and to take advantage of the super cute outdoor space.

I'm completely in love with this place. The food is so so good and they give you free queso!!! FREE! I go here every year for my birthday and anniversaries etc. and it's legit my favorite restaurant. All the staff are so sweet and the food is always so good and so cheap. Legit the best place in NOLA.
My go to spot for coffee and now breakfast. The customer service is Ahhhhmaaazzzziinnnngggg. They always take care of me here. Everything is delicious!

Woody's is a great spot. Which is the reason you need to be there early or late for lunch.
The place is owned by the same people that own Twisted Fork so the food has a very similar vibe. Waay better than standard bar food but still good for enjoying with a nice beer or your favorite cocktail. 
Staff are always super friendly and on point with service.
I would like to see a revolving tap as the beer selection doesnt seem to change.
All in all a really good locals spot for drinks and food.
Really cool spot. It's in an old house and has a beachy feel. The service was excellent and the food was just as good as the service. I'll be revisiting soon.

First time here and it was delicioso! The seafood stew special was loaded with mussels, clams, and shrimp and just a touch of spice. Our table had the linguine de la mer, veal caprese, and  gluten free pasta with crab in a marinara sauce. All dishes were prepared well, came very hot, and were good portions. A big shout out to our waiter Marco who allowed us to practice our "poor" Italian. Three guests, beverages, appetizers, mains, shared a dessert for $112 before tip! Go here!!

I stumbled upon this place while I was in Goleta the other day and craving Mexican food! They have a huge menu full of tacos, burritos, salads, nachos, and more! I spend some time trying to decide what to get since there is so many options to choose from. They have very huge salsa bar to choose from and they use some of the freshest ingredients.

The restaurant itself is clean, with great service, and delicious food! The prices are great and very affordable too! They even have an SB axxess card deal here too. The staff were able to answer all my questions and help me decide what I should eat. I decided to get a burrito with rice and beans as well as the nachos! The portions were huge so I ended up taking some to go for later.

I can't wait to come back the other food they have here! Looking forward to trying more of the delicious salsas from their huge salsa bar! :)
amazing flavor. didnt wait long, indoor seating, only wish the rolls were slightly bigger. but it was great and the fish was top notch
This is one of our all time favorite spots. We are moving and we'll be sad not to have it nearby but will definitely be back whenever we come to town.

My friend suggested we go here for dinner.  This place has been around forever, yet I haven't been there  in years.    Walked in around 7 on Saturday, they were busy, but still had availability at the bar and tables.   We sat at a high top in the bar area.  Started out with some cocktails, & the Tuscan Plate app, which was very good.   The had the prosciutto chicken, with mashed potatoes & asparagus.  It was a large portion & very good.  I took half home.  My friend had the filet, mashed potatoes & spinach.  She said it was very good.   I'm glad we went, because now I have another good place to eat, that's close to home.
This place was amazing service was the best our bartender Katonya  treated it like it was her own outstanding hospitality the food was great  5

This is a true hidden gem. Located in the commercial warehouse part of two on they gave an excellent dejection of Italian imported Ed meats and cheeses. 

Their deli cAse has an excellent assortment of Italian n fRR e li items and their sandwich list is the beat I gave seen in Tucson. 

Their is a very nice dining area. 

Their frozen food  section has take home items fit for a king. 

Wether for a lunch, hard to find Italian food items, or for a great take hoo me dinner this is a must.

Always love Nudy's. The food is always good cause I mean come on.. who can mess up breakfast? The staff are friendly and professional and I love the whole breakfast setting. It's very calming. If there's ever a day where I don't cook breakfast, Nudy's is the place to go!

All I can say is WOW. This food was remarkable, honestly one of the best meals I've ever had. I loved the laid back atmosphere too. 

We ordered a lot of food (brought half home with us - made for delicious leftovers the next day): 

- tandoori chicken poutine - flavor and texture is making my mouth water just thinking about it. 

- hot chicken dish with ghost pepper - so delicious, definitely spicy but not a lingering spice that has you dying for a glass of milk 

- naan with short rib -- maybe our favorite thing we had. such a unique twist on naan and the balance of taste and texture were delectable. 

- garlic and parmesan naan - perfectly cooked, perfect tasting, great for dipping! 

- chicken korma - the korma sauce was by far the best korma I've ever tried, and my other top favorite item we had. perfect balance of spices - really tasted the saffron and coriander with the perfect hint of spice but definitely not too spicy! the chicken was perfectly cooked and tender. 

- hummus - this was delicious, loved the fresh flavors of the cucumber and tomato. overall this was my least favorite of the dishes, but still better than any hummus we've ordered at a restaurant! 

Cocktails were also phenomenal. 

Please treat yourself and go here!! Highly highly recommend!!

Great meatball and that's coming from someone who knows the difference. 
It was a great time and good food but practice projecting your voice cause this place gets super loud. Lots of nodding and smiling on my part cause I couldn't hear a thing. Luckily the meal made up for it.

I arrived at 2:30 p.m. on a Saturday afternoon.  There was no line of customers waiting to order at the counter and only a few tables of lingering breakfast eaters.  I approached the register and someone came over to meet me (not greet me, just meet me).  I mentioned I was meeting someone and she was running late so I would just order a drink and then we would order food when she arrived.  I was immediately told that if she did not arrive and order before 3:00 we would be out of luck because they stopped serving food at 3:00.  I ask why would they close at 4:00 if they do not serve after 3:00? [I generally think the industry standard is to stop allowing orders just shortly before close (10-15 mins)] The answer was dodgy and I was then told they weren't even serving eggs after 2:00 on Saturday so all I could order was toast or soups.  Odd, I thought and I was not super happy since I had planned to order eggs.  After I ordered, I went to sit at a table.  Every table was dirty except one two-top.  For a place with 4 people behind the counter and no orders coming in, one would think they could wipe off the tables.  A big turn off for a first time customer.  My friend arrived at 2:50 p.m. and we ordered a croissant and an avocado toast.  The avocado toast is advertised to have dijon mustard, which seemed interesting in avocado toast and likely is but I won't know unless I make it at home because my avocado toast had brown mustard (yuck!) mixed into my avocado.  I think of avocado

Bustling and busy. We arrived at lunch hour and were seated fairly quickly. Service was fast. 
Here's the skinny: 
Nashville Hot Chicken Sandwich 4/5 - couldn't really eat as a sandwich. But tasty. 
Seasoned fries 5/5 - very good - nice and hot
Coleslaw - 5/5 - only wished there was more of it 
Skillet Mac - 4/5 - not quite up to the hype 
Bbq sliders - 3/5 - meh 
Black Abby IPA - 5/5 - really good IPA 
Bang for the buck - a little on the high side. Especially after paying $15 bucks for parking in a city lot - oh well 
Overall decent experience.
Loved the Aloo Tarkari and Samosas! Lots of wonderful vegan and vegetarian options here.
Fantastic food and service as always. I have been here several times and I've always had exceptional entrées and appetizers.
The best from the poboys to the gumbo great place to eat the staff is friendly and the food is top notch
The food was delicious and the service was great. The owner was very kind and made us feel welcome. We enjoyed our visit and will definitely be back!!

Amazing food, limited waiters and waitresses. But excellent authentic Italian cuisine! Definitely recommend and I would go back for sure!! You have to try their special Lobster Ravioli it's not on the menu

THE BEST ice cream. I am not a fan of vegan cheeses, milks, ice creams, and other alternatives. But Plant Love's ice cream is unlike anything I've ever had before. I PREFER it over normal ice cream. It's so much creamier, tastier, and even healthier/organic. I am obsessed with this place and always stop in whenever I'm downtown. I'll even buy pints to have on hand at home, and to support this amazing local business!
Restaurant owner harassed us and told us we were wrong. All we asked for was Tom Yum soup with lemongrass and kafir lime leaf.
Pretty good pizza ! At least staff was very nice and order came right out. That's what you want in a pizza joint fast, tasty, crunch. Thank you

I have no idea what authentic Indian food is supposed to taste like but if I'm ever asked, I'll say it's what they offer at the Green Chili. Lunch was provided fresh and hot with exotic herbs and spices that turned "Stop the car, I'm hungry" to "OMG, we're coming back for dinner". The chicken soup warmed my soul. The naan gave comfort. The butter chicken brought smiles. Try it!

Such a good restaurant but I placed an order during Covid spread expecting curbside pickup, as stated in their information on Yelp.  They do not have curbside and you must go in.
The employee kindly brought me my order outside .
Thank you

I was a little put off at first. The girl questioned how she could help us. Not sure it was my tattoos or not but regardless  we still  got a table after waiting at the bar. Service fantastic. My filet was cook to  perfection. I would have cooked the scallops 60 seconds less. And the asparagus to al dente. My husbands rice was cooked perfect but needs salt. Salt makes all the flavor come  together. We would come back! And great wine list! Love that  would could select a  Rioja or Bordeaux!!

This is one of the worst buffalo wild wings I've ever been to. Once I entered, the place reeks of sweat and old spilled beer. I decided to get takeout and a young lady took my order. I waited about 30 minutes. She finally gave me my bag of food and it was A MESS. My sauce was spilled all over the inside of the bag mixed with other flavored wings I ordered, and barely any fries. I came in for this order at night. I came back another time during the day, and service was much better and more organized. A nice waitress even asked if i wanted to check my order before I left. Coming here at night is a no go.
Love the "crack" chicken and loco moco! Price is fitting and appreciate the variety of their menu! It caters to all! Definitely need to drop by everytime we're in Reno!
Perfection! Absolutely delicious. So much care and love in the food. Authentic.  Had a sampling of empanadas and arepas.  Will go back ASAP for more!

Wonderful and easy online take out ordering.  They did forget my son's muffin, but not a big deal when getting used to all of the changes.  I've been back and notice every time how careful they are being with regard to wearing masks and handling food.  It's delicious as well!  Thank you so much!

Love this spot! They have boost slushees, and GREAT food!! The menu is soo South Jersey, the ice cream flavors are wild & the staff is so friendly and accommodating. Shannon is my favorite employee!! I would come in a few times a week to get a boost and she would know my order as soon as I walked in :)

Everything we had here was amazing! 

Here's what we tried and would recommend all of it:
Scallion pancakes
Fried mini buns
House special soup with shaved noodles
Pork fried rice

Everything was cooked perfectly and was delicious! 

Restaurant is cash only, but they have an ATM in the lobby.

Favorite Mexican restaurant in St. Pete!! The steak quesadilla is phenomenal!! Every time I go, I want to try something else but always get the quesadilla because it is THAT good. Really good and cheap house margs during happy hour, which I believe is every day until 7. But I could be wrong! Highly recommend and always take out of towners here.

Since i moved here in Reno from Newyork i was trying to look some good places to hang out and chill i tried everywhere specially in downtown area but when i first came to Lucky beaver i feel so Welcomed and Relaxed with the bartenders specially Drake and Andrew (bartenders) Swing/Graveshift and the food is The best  i recommend all the foods they have in the Menu.! 100% True !

Never EVER disappoints .... super fresh and the menu is so varied with lots of authentic Japanese food, as well as true sushi, sashimi and rolls galore. I don't know what I would do without my Edomasa ... Tai is such a great owner too! He has been consistently providing top of the line quality sushi and has great employees that have been there for such a long time.  It's hands down the best sushi restaurant in Santa Barbara!

We have gone to Claim Jumpers for their beef ribs for years. I like the cashew chicken sandwich. Claim Jumpers has neither of these. We asked the waitstaff who was very attentive. He explained that it was a new owner and beef ribs were not cost effective. 
Well...the ribs are gone, the sandwich I like is gone... So are we

If I could give them zero stars I would not.  They really aren't that bad.  But there are some things I just don't like that keep me from being a regular here, even tho its closer, and less busy, than my other 2 goto spots.  That is normally when I end up here, when the wait is to long at the other places...

The parking lot can be terrible.  It really is tight back there...Getting in and out is the worst on a busy Saturday Morning.  Just try not to hit any of the pedestrians and you should be OK.

I can't stand the "blend of cheeses" they offer.  Who wants a blend of cheeses?  What exactly is a blend of cheeses?  This tells me they have big bags of pre shredded cheese in the kitchen.  Isn't that stuff mostly sawdust?  I want American Cheese in my omelette.  Take your blend of cheeses back to home depot.  

Atmosphere.  It's just lacking.  Seems so formal.  Even first watch seems friendlier\warmer and that pales in comparison to the love you get at Sabrina's.  

I'll be back, I'm just in no rush.

I'm stuck inside for three weeks now because of corona virus and I just found this place and I'm crying cause it's so good and everything perfect and I'm so thankful you're still open and just really thank you your food is delicious

What's great about the cafe is that you don't have to worry about quick service. Was in there this afternoon at store then popped over with idea to get tea and so forth. Tall guy with white hair was able to move in and out of kitchen joking with staff while customers waited. They make enough money I guess. So much for supporting local.

The ambience is bright and open. The staff was friendly and the restaurant was clean.
I was disappointed in the selection of sauces. I was also surprised to find that the sauces come on the side- not tossed. Also- there wasn't any sauces that were *actually* hot. I like spicy- but the jalapeño ranch did not satisfy my heat tooth. It was run of the mill friend chicken. It was definitely good- but not great. The fries were soggy, but they gave large portions so I did feel like I got my money's worth.

Strongbow Cider & Hacker-Pschorr Oktoberfest - Check
Pierogi's with white sauce - Check
Zigeuner Schnitzel & Sour Creme Pork Schnitzel - Check
We love this place! The food, the service is always on point! Thank you Mr Dunderbak's for an escape that is always fun and delicious.

I want another
My order: bacon egg cheese on kaiser with onions and hot peppers
It was delicious

White Dog is great. The service is always super friendly, decor is cute, and food is delicious. The spicy lamb bolognese is our favorite (seriously SO good). I tried the truffle gnocchi last night and it was YUM. It is our go-to place for dinner when my BF's parents visit.

This shop only caters to rich older middle aged people. If you are younger than 25 dont come here. I came for my birthday and actually had money to leave a good tip contrary to the idea that younger adults dont tip. They treated us like teenagers the whole time and rushed our meal. It took 20 minutes to receive slices of cake. The cake was dry and did not live up to the hype. The waitress  was forcing to go boxes to us before we were even finished with our meals. She was giving us advice on how to fit it all in the box before we were done. She didnt even ask if we wanted a box. She wanted us to get out as fast as possible and thats now how you run a restaurant. The restaurant was out of 25% of their items that were listed on the menu. I was excited to try cake bake for my birthday and had the worst experience here with the treatment from the staff and the mediocre food. Save money and go somewhere else because the aesthetic of cake bake is not worth it. Im disappointed and shocked that my group of friends were treated so poorly because the waitress assumed that we wouldnt tip her. We didnt tip well because of the not so deserving staff, not because we were young. Stop stereotyping your guests. I dont think i will come back and will let people know my experience here.

Went to the newer location near West County mall. The #25 cheeseburger never dissapoints. The staff here is super friendly.Good beer selection and even have taps at your table if you want. Just so sad with the Covid 19 mandated rules. The dinning room only had a few people on a Saturday. I feel bad for all the resturants trying to make it during these times.

I am new to Yelp and the area, and I have to say, The Deck has made me feel excited to try the local fair after giving them a try. They were warm and welcoming from the time I walked in the door, from the manger down to the rest of the staff. The views are gorgeous, the drink selection is fantastic, and the food was much more than bar food that you typically find. Well done! I cannot say enough about how the manager handled my requests from start to finish. I will absolutely be back!
Had a fabulous brunch with yummy cocktails. Angie was a fantastic server/bartender! Would recommend brunch and happy hours yummies.

Nothing says Sunday brunch to Reno locals like Sasquatch does. Full breakfast and lunch menu and free champagne with breakfast baby! Soooo do you want eggs, chicken fried steak, salmon Benedict, steamed clams??? You got it all here and it rocks!! The steamers are small, tender and plentiful topped with fresh diced garlic, shredded parm and served with 2 big toasties to soak up the juicy juice in the bottom of the bowl. I love their Bloody Mary's here too made with a perfectly seasoned very tasty house mix. Not fancy but oh so good . The staff is great, friendly and inviting. We called 15 minutes ahead for a table for 4 and they sat us right away. Good times.

Had this place twice during Covid and it did not disappoint. Excellent burgers and new fries. Chicken tenders are a must!! They apparently did a new fry recipe that makes some great fries with their homemade ranch and ketchup. Pickup service is prompt and extremely friendly. A once a week go-to for this family.
It was ok. Great salad but the meal was mediocre. The champagne sauce was overly sweet and to me ruined the taste of my fish.
